text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانٍۢ كَفُورٍ

words.gloss_range: emphatic clause-opening particle that frames the defense statement as an asserted fact

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: ongoing divine defense or repulsion on behalf of the protected class

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the ayah by making divine defense an asserted proposition before the action verb appears. Its short launch and governed clause frame make the reader hear certainty first, then the heavier ongoing defense in {{ar:يُدَٰفِعُ}} ({{tr:yudāfiʿu}}).

topics.headline: first emphatic clause launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins as settled assertion, not as an unframed narrative report.
topics.reason: The first particle governs the named subject and presents the defense verb as the predicate of an emphatic clause.

topics.headline: compact onset before defense verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a compact assertion expand into a longer defense action.
topics.reason: The short opening particle precedes the longer defense verb and supports the sound-shape observation without changing the syntax.

words.gloss_range: the definite proper divine name as the governed subject of the first emphatic defense clause
words.root_gloss_range: worship, awe, refuge, and disputed love-language associations remain name-pressure, while the local word functions as the proper divine name

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the repeated proper divine name in the second emphatic clause

words.prose: As the governed name after {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) fixes the defense clause on the named divine subject rather than on an abstract principle. The proper-name form blocks a generic deity reading, while the root and derivational evidence keeps worship, awe, refuge, and disputed love-language pressure around the name. Because the name returns in the second half, this first occurrence also starts a two-beat architecture: the same subject who defends believers is the subject who does not love the betrayer-ingrate class. The same-surah network makes that defense a principle before permission to fight follows (22:39) and before guidance to believers is stated with the same divine-believer pairing (22:54).

topics.headline: named divine subject under first emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that defense is attributed to the named divine agent, not left as an abstract protection principle.
topics.reason: The word is the definite proper noun governed by the first emphatic particle and supplies the subject for the defense predicate.

topics.headline: divine-name semantic pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proper name is not a neutral label; awe, worship, refuge, and disputed love-language pressure stand behind the repeated name.
topics.reason: The local surface remains a proper divine name, so the derivational material colors the name rather than replacing it with a common-noun sense.

topics.headline: first half of repeated divine frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first divine name prepares a matched frame in which defense and non-love are coordinated under one subject.
topics.reason: The two emphatic clauses repeat the same named subject, and the first occurrence is audibly bound to its particle before the predicate arrives.

topics.headline: principle before later application
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this divine defense statement sits inside a same-surah network where believers receive divine action, including the following permission context (22:39) and guidance language (22:54).
topics.reason: The cited same-surah references support a local network of divine action toward believers without changing the local grammar of the proper name.

words.gloss_range: ongoing divine defense, repulsion, and warding off on behalf of believers, with the repelled threat left unstated
words.root_gloss_range: pushing, repelling, warding off, contending, and handing over or payment branches; the local construction with {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}) selects repulsion and defense, not payment as a free local sense

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition marking defense away from harm and on behalf of the protected group

words.prose: {{ar:يُدَٰفِعُ}} ({{tr:yudāfiʿu}}) gives the first clause its ongoing action: divine defense is active, sustained, and aimed on behalf of {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:alladhīna āmanū}}). The missing direct object leaves the threat unnamed, so the defense is not limited to one visible enemy. The root keeps the bodily image of pushing away, and {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}) selects that repulsion-away direction; payment or hand-over senses remain outside the local branch. The Form III reading and its Form I contrast make the action feel like engaged defense rather than a single bare shove, while the long ā and final ʿayn slow the recitation into sustained force. After the prior commission to announce glad tidings (22:37), the verb becomes the declared content of divine defense; 22:40 and 2:251 then show the wider divine-repulsion pattern.

topics.headline: ongoing defense with unstated threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine defense is ongoing and broad because the repelled object is left unstated.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect active and has no explicit direct object while governing the protected group through a prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: pushing-away branch selected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels protection as harm being pushed away from believers, while the payment or hand-over branch is kept from becoming the local sense.
topics.reason: The construction with the following preposition licenses defense and repulsion away from the beneficiary; other root branches are not selected by this local frame.

topics.headline: Form III sustained contention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the marked form presents defense as sustained engagement, with the Form I variant sharpening the contrast.
topics.reason: The local surface carries the long-vowel Form III reading, and accepted variant evidence can clarify the pressure without replacing the aligned surface.

topics.headline: systemic divine-repulsion pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this verb as a principle that later becomes concrete in the same surah (22:40) and in the wider pushing-back pattern (2:251).
topics.reason: The cited references preserve a real inter-ayah pattern while the local beneficiary remains the belief-defined group.

topics.headline: boundary handoff into declared defense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and tracks a transition from prior commission and guardedness into a declared, directional defense.
topics.reason: The cadence and boundary rows converge with the imperfect form and following preposition; the rarity note reinforces the markedness of the local defense wording.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking defense away from harm and on behalf of the belief-defined group
words.prose: {{ar:عَنِ}} ({{tr:ʿani}}) is the hinge that turns defense toward a beneficiary. With {{ar:يُدَٰفِعُ}} ({{tr:yudāfiʿu}}), it holds two pressures together: harm is pushed away from the group, and the action is performed on their behalf. Because it governs the whole relative phrase {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:alladhīna āmanū}}), the protected object is the entire belief-defined class, not merely the next word. Its nūn and the following al- onset also make the preposition and relative phrase sound like a tight governed unit.

topics.headline: benefactive separation after defense verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition marks both removal away from harm and defense on behalf of the whole protected group.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence shows the preposition linking the defense verb to the relative phrase as its governed complement.

topics.headline: audible link to relative phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the preposition as tightly bound to the relative phrase it governs.
topics.reason: The sound note reinforces the syntactic unit already established by the prepositional attachment.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun introducing the clause that defines the defended group

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: completed entry into belief, trust, and security

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does not name the defended group outright; it waits for {{ar:ءَامَنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) to define them. The plural relative form makes the beneficiary a human class constituted by the relative clause, and the boundary from 22:37 recasts the addressed worshippers as third-person defended believers.

topics.headline: protected group defined by relative clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the protected class is defined by its act of believing or trusting, not by a tribe or fixed label.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is completed by the following plural verb, and attachment evidence treats that verb as the relative clause.

topics.headline: audience recast as defended class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a shift from prior direct address into a third-person protected class.
topics.reason: The boundary observation is compatible with the local third-person relative phrase and helps explain the discourse turn.

words.gloss_range: completed plural act of believing, trusting, and entering security that defines the defended class
words.root_gloss_range: security, safety from fear, trust, faith, and entrusting; the local Form IV perfect selects belief/trust-entry as the class marker
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) completes the relative clause and makes the protected class people who have already entered belief, trust, and security. The perfect plural form marks this as a completed class-defining act, while the root's security field makes divine defense feel like an answer to the very identity named. Across the ayah, that trust-security identity stands opposite {{ar:خَوَّانٍۢ}} ({{tr:khawwānin}}) and {{ar:كَفُورٍ}} ({{tr:kafūrin}}): trust kept is defended, trust eroded and truth covered are excluded.

topics.headline: completed belief defines the class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the protected group is defined by a completed act, not by an attempted or merely potential state.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect 3mp and completes the relative phrase whose subject is the preceding plural relative pronoun.

topics.headline: belief as entry into security
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is not flattened to mental assent; it carries trust and security pressure that matches the defense verb.
topics.reason: The Form IV local sense is belief/trust, and the root field licenses security pressure without replacing the surface verb.

topics.headline: trust opposed to betrayal and covering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's two halves as a moral polarity between trust-security and the later betrayal-covering class.
topics.reason: The later adjectives provide a local semantic inverse to the trust-security field while the cited co-occurrence evidence supports the polarity.

topics.headline: same group under different divine verbs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same belief-defined group receives different divine actions in the surah, including entry at 22:14 and defense here.
topics.reason: The same-surah and boundary references preserve a real beneficiary pattern without altering the local perfect verb.

words.gloss_range: second emphatic clause-opening particle that restarts assertion for the rejection clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: divine evaluative love or approval under negation
negated divine love or approval predicate

words.prose: The second {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) reopens the ayah with a coequal assertion instead of letting the rejection clause trail as an afterthought. By repeating the same emphatic frame as the opening, it makes {{ar:لَا يُحِبُّ}} ({{tr:lā yuḥibbu}}) stand beside divine defense as a second declared principle. It also completes the handoff from the prior resumptive transition (22:37) into the emphatic content of this new declaration.

topics.headline: second clause gets equal assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the non-love clause is independently asserted with the same force as the defense clause.
topics.reason: The second emphatic particle governs a new named subject and predicate, matching the structure of the first clause.

topics.headline: transition into emphatic content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the discourse handoff from prior transition into the second emphatic declaration.
topics.reason: The boundary observation is compatible with the local restart of the emphatic clause.

words.gloss_range: the repeated definite proper divine name as the governed subject of the negated love clause
words.root_gloss_range: worship, awe, refuge, and disputed love-language associations remain name-pressure while the local word functions as the repeated proper divine name

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first occurrence of the proper divine name in the defense clause
divine evaluative love or approval under negation
negated divine love or approval predicate

words.prose: The repeated {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) refuses to let the second clause rely on ellipsis. The same named subject who defended believers is now explicitly placed before {{ar:لَا يُحِبُّ}} ({{tr:lā yuḥibbu}}), so protection and evaluative rejection come from one referent. The name's worship, awe, refuge, and disputed love-language pressure is especially pointed here because the predicate is about withheld love or approval.

topics.headline: same subject repeated before opposite predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second predicate is not loosely attached; it is explicitly anchored to the same named subject.
topics.reason: The second proper divine name is the governed subject of the second emphatic clause rather than an omitted carryover.

topics.headline: derivational pressure before non-love
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the divine-name semantic field sharpened by its placement before a love or approval predicate.
topics.reason: The local word remains the proper divine name, while its co-occurrence with the love verb licenses evaluative name-pressure.

topics.headline: second half completes repeated frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's two halves as controlled counterparts through the repeated divine-name frame.
topics.reason: The repeated emphatic subject frame forces comparison between defense in the first half and negated love in the second.

words.gloss_range: negation particle scoping over the imperfect love verb and its universal trait-class object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: every habitual betrayer and intensified ingrate

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) turns the second predicate into a habitual exclusion: not a past refusal, but an ongoing denial of divine love or approval. Its scope covers {{ar:يُحِبُّ}} ({{tr:yuḥibbu}}) together with {{ar:كُلَّ خَوَّانٍۢ كَفُورٍ}} ({{tr:kulla khawwānin kafūrin}}), so the whole trait-class is excluded, not just one descriptor.

topics.headline: negated imperfect gives ongoing non-love
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rejection is general and ongoing, not a one-time past denial.
topics.reason: The negation particle precedes an imperfect verb, producing habitual predicate negation.

topics.headline: negation scopes over whole object phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the universal trait-class as a whole falls under the negated love predicate.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence places the quantifier phrase as the object of the negated verb, so negation is not restricted to one adjective.

topics.headline: direct turn into negative predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the second clause move directly from renewed assertion into negated evaluation.
topics.reason: After the second emphatic particle and repeated subject, the predicate immediately begins with negation.

words.gloss_range: divine evaluative love, approval, or affinity under negation, directed toward the universal trait-class object
words.root_gloss_range: love, affection, approval, affinity, and grain or seed/core imagery; the local divine-moral context selects evaluative approval while allowing core-affinity pressure
words.prose: Under {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), {{ar:يُحِبُّ}} ({{tr:yuḥibbu}}) becomes habitual non-love or non-approval toward the object class. Because the subject is the divine name and the object is a moral descriptor phrase, the local sense is evaluative approval rather than mere emotion. The Form IV verb also belongs to the recurring {{ar:لَا يُحِبُّ}} ({{tr:lā yuḥibbu}}) divine-rejection formula, here specialized by habitual treachery and intense ingratitude as the excluded object. The root's grain or core association can survive as image-pressure: the negation denies any core affinity with {{ar:كُلَّ خَوَّانٍۢ كَفُورٍ}} ({{tr:kulla khawwānin kafūrin}}), while the selected sense remains divine evaluative love.

topics.headline: ongoing negated love toward object class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb's positive sense is reversed under negation and applied transitively to the whole trait-class.
topics.reason: The negation scopes over the imperfect transitive verb and its explicit quantifier object.

topics.headline: love as divine evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine love here functions as approval or affinity within a recurring rejection formula.
topics.reason: The divine subject, negative moral object, and recurring formula support evaluative approval rather than private emotion.

topics.headline: seed-core image under negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the negation as denial of core affinity, while the local verb still means divine love or approval.
topics.reason: The grain or seed branch provides image-pressure, but local grammar and the divine evaluative formula keep love or approval as the selected sense.

words.gloss_range: accusative totality quantifier distributing the negated-love verdict across every member of the betrayer-ingrate class
words.root_gloss_range: totality, entirety, encompassing, and crown-like enclosing pressure; the local word selects exhaustive quantification

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: divine evaluative love or approval under negation

words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) is the object pivot between negated divine love and the two moral descriptors. As an accusative quantifier in construct with an indefinite descriptor, it distributes the verdict across every matching individual, not merely a collective type. Its root's encompassing pressure fits the local force: the entire betrayer-ingrate class is wrapped under the non-love verdict. The word also turns the clause into a universally scoped moral classification, narrower than the broad group-separating use in the same surah (22:17) and aligned with universalizing fields that include 17:89, 14:34, 31:32, and 2:276.

topics.headline: distributive totality as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that every individual fitting the descriptor is included under the negated-love verdict.
topics.reason: The quantifier is accusative as the direct object and forms a construct with the following indefinite genitive descriptor.

topics.headline: encompassing root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels totality as an enclosing verdict while the local sense remains exhaustive quantification.
topics.reason: The root image supports the local quantifier but does not add an independent non-quantifier sense.

topics.headline: pivot from negation to descriptors
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the word turn the clause from negated love into a universally scoped moral classification, with same-surah and cross-reference support such as 22:17, 17:89, 14:34, 31:32, and 2:276.
topics.reason: The quantifier stands between the negated love verb and the descriptor pair, and the cited references support a universalizing field without changing the local construct grammar.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive intensive adjective naming any habitual betrayer as the class complement under totality
words.root_gloss_range: betrayal, treachery, violating or diminishing what is entrusted; the local intensive form selects habitual trust-violation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: completed entry into belief, trust, and security

words.prose: {{ar:خَوَّانٍۢ}} ({{tr:khawwānin}}) supplies the class over which {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) ranges. Its genitive indefinite form makes the target any habitual betrayer, not a named antagonist, and it binds with {{ar:كَفُورٍ}} ({{tr:kafūrin}}) as one object phrase. The root's trust-violation field makes it the inverse of {{ar:ءَامَنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}): the protected group enters trust and security, while this label names repeated erosion of what is entrusted. Its betrayal field reaches treaty and personal settings (8:58; 12:52), and the guttural opening with the doubled wāw gives the habitual betrayal label audible weight.

topics.headline: indefinite class under totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rejected object is any member of a described class, not a named enemy.
topics.reason: The word is the genitive complement of the quantifier and the head for the following descriptor.

topics.headline: betrayal inverses belief-trust
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the protected trust-security class opposed by a figure whose identity is repeated trust-violation.
topics.reason: The root sense of betrayal coheres with the local contrast against the earlier belief/trust verb.

topics.headline: habitual betrayal pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form marks settled or repeated betrayal rather than one isolated betrayal.
topics.reason: The local adjective is an intensive pattern, and the contextual profile marks the form as rare.

topics.headline: betrayal field across contexts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local intensive label abstracts a betrayal field visible in treaty and personal contexts such as 8:58 and 12:52, while 22:25 shows another same-surah dimension of rejection.
topics.reason: The cited references provide concrete recurrence and contrast without overriding the local intensive adjective.

topics.headline: heavy sound matches betrayal label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the heavy doubled sound as matching the semantic weight of habitual betrayal.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is local to the surface form and supports the same intensive betrayal payoff.

words.gloss_range: genitive intensive descriptor adding settled ingratitude, denial, and covering-over to the betrayer class
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, denial, disbelief, and ingratitude, with reparative covering branches elsewhere; the local intensive adjective selects blameworthy covering-over and chronic ingratitude

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: completed entry into belief, trust, and security
paired habitual betrayal and intensified ingratitude

words.prose: {{ar:كَفُورٍ}} ({{tr:kafūrin}}) closes the ayah by adding a second, semi-independent descriptor to {{ar:خَوَّانٍۢ}} ({{tr:khawwānin}}). Its root keeps the image of covering or concealing, but the local intensive form selects blameworthy ingratitude and denial, not reparative covering elsewhere in the root family. As the final word, it seals the class as both trust-breaking and deeply ungrateful, the inverse of the trust-security opened by {{ar:ءَامَنُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}). The paired genitive tanwīn endings bind {{ar:خَوَّانٍۢ كَفُورٍ}} ({{tr:khawwānin kafūrin}}) as one closing sound-unit, while recurrence at 14:34, 17:67, 22:66, and 42:48 keeps the word inside a chronic-ingratitude type.

topics.headline: second descriptor stacks onto betrayal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing adjective is not redundant; it adds another characterization inside the same rejected class.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the word as a genitive descriptor agreeing with the preceding intensive adjective.

topics.headline: covering image as blameworthy ingratitude
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels ingratitude as a covering-over of received truth or benefit, while the local sense remains blameworthy denial rather than every root branch.
topics.reason: The root's covering range supports the local adjective, but expiation or reparative covering branches are not selected by this moral descriptor.

topics.headline: deep intensive quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices settled, ingrained ingratitude rather than an occasional failure to thank.
topics.reason: The local word is an intensive adjective at the ayah's close, concentrating a common root into a marked quality.

topics.headline: betrayal and ingratitude fuse at the close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah close on a fully scoped, paired intensive class: trust-breaking joined to covering ingratitude.
topics.reason: The word stands as the final member of the adjective pair under the universal negated-love construction, and the paired endings bind the traits audibly.

topics.headline: recurring chronic-ingratitude type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places the closing descriptor inside a wider chronic-ingratitude vocabulary, including 14:34, 17:67, 22:66, 42:48, and same-surah occurrences such as 22:19, 22:25, 22:55, 22:57, and 22:72.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows provide concrete Quranic parallels while the local grammar keeps the word as the final intensive descriptor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction يُدَافِعُ عَنِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا is followed by the opposed pair خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine دفع turns injury away from people characterized by trust and heart-settling assent; the second clause names the contrary mechanism, repeated breach of what was entrusted and concealment of received good. Protection and non-love therefore describe opposite sides of a fidelity relation rather than two unrelated claims.

activation_trace.role: Literal removal of a thing and warding of harm supplies the main protective counterforce around the believers.
Security, trust, and entrusted reliability supply the relational quality around which that warding operates.
Heart-settling assent keeps the protected identity from being reduced to mere group membership.
Love as an attachment abiding in the heart makes لا يحب a denial of sustaining relational attachment.
Deficient fidelity to covenant or trust supplies the active relational breach opposed to faith.
Concealment and denial of benefaction turns the breach into ingratitude for what protection has given.

changed_reading.before: God protects believers and dislikes two generic bad traits.
changed_reading.after: God continually counters harm around a trust-bearing relation, while chronic betrayal and covered-over benefaction identify the disposition that breaks that relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The دفع verb, its عن complement, and the exhaustive كُلَّ خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ permit a material reading of pressures being moved away.
baseline_models.mechanism: The flood, wave, crowd, and watercourse branches make defense look less like an inert wall and more like the routing of accumulating force. The directional arrow comes from عن: hostile pressure is carried off from the zone of trust before gradual depletion and covering can master it.

activation_trace.role: A torrent, wave, or crowd pushing in mass supplies the literal image of accumulated pressure that must be redirected.
Watercourses and outlets supply channels as the functional means by which pressure is carried away rather than merely stopped.
Security and settled trust define the protected zone from which the pressure is routed.
Gradual depletion supplies the internal erosion that unchecked pressure can produce.
Covering supplies the terminal occlusion of trust that the routing mechanism prevents.

changed_reading.before: Defense is a static shield interposed once between believers and an attacker.
changed_reading.after: Defense can be imagined as continuous pressure management: converging forces are given another course away from trust before they become depletion and occlusion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier coupling of disbelief with turning people away from God's path, followed by equal sanctuary access for resident and visitor, gives the focus defense an access-preserving function. The betraying ingrate is no longer only a private moral failure; it can be an agent who converts a shared sacred trust into exclusion.

activation_trace.role: Warding and removal anchor the changed reading in the focus action of countering exclusionary harm.
Breach of entrusted right lets the focus accusation attach to misuse of a shared sanctuary.
Covering or denying truth is literally paired there with obstruction and functions as the context's identified hostile agency.
Turning away and diverting supplies the precise access-blocking motion that divine دفع counteracts.
Equality between two parties supplies the public-access norm preserved by the counterforce.

structural_cues: 22:25 places obstruction, the sanctuary, and equal standing in one construction before 22:38 announces divine دفع عن those who believe.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked sacred access and resident-visitor equality; I infer that the later defense protects that access and that exclusion is a form of betrayed trust. Personal or military protection remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The verse promises protection from unspecified personal harm.
changed_reading.after: The verse can promise preservation of open sacred access against agents who betray a common trust by diverting others from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding rite moves entrusted provision through subjection, eating, feeding, gratitude, and inward taqwa rather than transfer of flesh or blood to God. Against that sequence, خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ can name a broken circulation: appropriating the gift while suppressing its entrusted social and grateful purpose. Divine defense protects not bare possession but a faithful passage from gift to sharing to gratitude.

activation_trace.role: Protective warding anchors the proposed preservation of an entrusted ethical circulation.
Failure of fidelity supplies the breach by which an entrusted gift is diverted from its due use.
Concealing benefaction supplies the endpoint of receiving provision without rendering its gratitude.
Feeding another is the literal outward transfer that makes the provision socially circulatory.
Subjection and direction toward a purpose marks the animal as entrusted means rather than autonomous possession.
Recognition of a benefaction supplies the explicit opposite of the focus verse's concealment of benefaction.
Placing oneself in protection supplies taqwa as the inward human response paired with divine protection.

structural_cues: 22:36 orders eating and feeding before gratitude; 22:37 denies that flesh or blood reaches God and says taqwa does; 22:38 then pairs betrayal with ingratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a gift-sharing-gratitude sequence and then the paired accusations; I infer that interruption of that sequence is one species of betrayal and that defense preserves its beneficiaries and norm. A purely ritual contrast or a broader moral accusation remains possible.

changed_reading.before: كَفُورٍ is a general doctrinal label appended after a protection promise.
changed_reading.after: In this local sequence, betrayal and ingratitude can describe capturing an entrusted gift while blocking its passage into feeding, taqwa, and acknowledged benefaction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following sequence makes the focus promise operational: people under reciprocal attack are permitted to act because rights were withheld; God's دفع of some people by others prevents worship places from being demolished; support culminates in enabled prayer, almsgiving, recognized right, and restraint of wrong. Defense is thus mediated counterforce preserving a civic-ritual ecology, not a guarantee that believers never suffer.

activation_trace.role: Warding harm is the focus promise that the following verses specify through agents, causes, and protected effects.
Reciprocal fighting supplies the concrete two-sided pressure in which defensive permission becomes relevant.
Withholding and confinement from a right supplies the stated moral asymmetry inside reciprocal combat.
Vindication of the wronged supplies the remedial aim of divine support rather than conquest for its own sake.
The repeated root literally makes some people the means of warding others and specifies divine defense as mediated counteraction.
Pulling down a building supplies the prevented material consequence and fixes preservation, not mere victory, as the mechanism's output.
A place of prostration supplies one concrete protected node within the wider list of worship places.
Capacity and enablement supply the post-defense condition in which public worship and ethical institutions can operate.

structural_cues: 22:39 begins with permission to those being fought, 22:40 repeats دفع and states the demolition counterfactual, and 22:41 describes what the defended group does when enabled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wronged combatants, people counteracting people, threatened demolition, and enabled practices; I supply the arrow that these are means and ends of 22:38's defense. Direct divine rescue and narrower protection of believers remain coexisting readings.

changed_reading.before: God's defense means believers will be kept outside conflict and loss.
changed_reading.after: God's defense can work through bounded human counterforce to prevent the destruction of worship space and preserve the conditions for prayer, giving, and public moral restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later cast-remove-firm-test-guide sequence activates a nonphysical mode of دفع. Believers are not protected from exposure to intrusive material; the intrusion is surfaced, removed with a successor, and the signs are made firm so the encounter differentiates diseased resistance from informed, humbled faith. Defense can therefore be filtration and consolidation rather than insulation.

activation_trace.role: Removal and warding anchor the epistemic proposal in the focus verb rather than in an independent theme.
Heart-settling assent supplies the faculty whose consolidation is the proposed protected outcome.
Removal followed by a replacement supplies the filtration step rather than simple suppression.
Firm construction, precision, and reliability supply consolidation of the signs after removal.
Testing metal or a person supplies differentiation as an allowed effect of exposure.
Gentle indication toward the true path supplies the directed outcome of the filtering process.

structural_cues: 22:52 sequences alien casting, divine removal, and firming; 22:53 names a test; 22:54 ends in belief, humbled hearts, and guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the epistemic sequence; I analogically assign it as one mode of the focus verb's warding because its endpoint is strengthened faith. These verses may instead describe revelation alone, leaving 22:38 primarily physical or political.

changed_reading.before: Defense keeps every disturbing input from reaching believers.
changed_reading.after: One exploratory mode of defense permits exposure, removes the corrupting insertion, firms what is true, and turns the encounter into more discerning faith.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing commands place strenuous action and public witness inside a relation of holding fast to God as patron and helper. This makes the protected believers of 22:38 active bearers of an entrusted testimony: divine defense holds and supports them so they can exert themselves, remain present, and witness, rather than turning them into passive clients.

activation_trace.role: Protective warding supplies the enabling support whose beneficiary is re-read as an active witness.
Trust and entrusted reliability make the defended identity capable of carrying testimony as a charge.
Exerting one's capacity under hardship supplies the believers' active response inside the protective relation.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies the public function for which protected endurance is needed.
A hold that prevents and preserves supplies the believer's reciprocal attachment to the source of defense.
Love, support, and alliance supply patronage as the relational form of divine defense.
Aid that makes its object manifest supplies the helper function completing that patronage.

structural_cues: 22:78 moves from exertion and chosen witnesshood to commanded اعتصام and the paired titles مولى and نصير.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commands, witnesshood, holding fast, patronage, and help; I infer that 22:38's defense enables this vocation and entails responsive agency. The closing duties may be consequences rather than semantic content of the focus promise.

changed_reading.before: Believers are passive objects of a unilateral shield.
changed_reading.after: Believers are held and aided so they can spend effort, remain reliable, and bear public witness; protection enables responsibility rather than replacing it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 22:73 concerns the incapacity of invoked rivals and 22:38 says ward away, not explicitly recover after seizure. It remains anchored in the focus دفع as protective action and gains a visible contrast from failed extraction out of another's hold. Render it only as a capacity contrast that may extend defense into rescue, not as a replacement gloss for يُدَافِعُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The protective action in يُدَافِعُ عَن can be tested against the later scene of powers unable to retrieve what has been seized.

activation_trace.role: Warding and protection supply the focus capacity whose possible rescue threshold is being explored.
The literal fly supplies the deliberately minimal hostile taker against which claimed protective power fails.
Extraction from a predicament or another's hand supplies the exact rescue act the rival powers cannot perform.
Lack of strength supplies the explicit incapacity that contrasts with effective divine defense.

changed_reading.before: Protection only means preventing an initial approach.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory edge, divine defense may include the effective extraction of what hostile agency has seized, precisely the rescue false powers cannot accomplish.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This branch crossing is surprising because يُحِبُّ means love in the construction and كَفُورٍ is not being called a farmer. It remains root-anchored through the packet's seed, seed-covering, and depletion images, which form a coherent latent growth analogy. Downstream prose must mark it as an image of moral cultivation and failed stewardship, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacent roots ح ب ب, خ و ن, and ك ف ر permit an exploratory seed-trust-covering image inside لا يحب كل خوان كفور.

activation_trace.role: The seed that germinates and bears grain supplies a latent image for what sustaining love would cultivate.
Gradual diminution supplies betrayal as depletion of entrusted germinal potential.
The farmer's literal covering of seed supplies the ambiguous burial image that failed stewardship turns from cultivation into concealment.

changed_reading.before: Divine non-love is only a flat verdict of rejection.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, divine love refuses to cultivate a pattern that depletes an entrusted seed and converts its necessary covering into moral concealment.

strongest_changes: The direct repetition of دفع in 22:40 turns a general protection promise into mediated counterforce that prevents demolition and preserves worship and public ethical practice.
The pre-focus gift-feeding-gratitude sequence lets خَوَّانٍ كَفُورٍ describe interruption of entrusted provision, not only abstract unbelief.
The closing اعتصام, patronage, help, and witness sequence makes defended believers responsible agents rather than passive beneficiaries.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse became a hinge: backward context supplied sacred access and faithful circulation, forward context disclosed conflict, institutional preservation, epistemic filtration, and witness-bearing agency. The hydrodynamic, retrieval, and cultivation images remain alongside the stronger civic and covenantal readings without being promoted to exclusive glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the reciprocal force felt in يُدَافِعُ should be treated as intrinsic to the form or chiefly activated by 22:40's people-by-people construction.
Whether لا يحب كل خوان كفور states a criterion limiting the protected class, a consequence of betrayal, or an independently coordinated judgment.
How far the epistemic filtration and retrieval models may extend the focus promise beyond its immediate physical and social horizon.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Trust receives an active protective counterforce.** `د ف ع B001` is pushing away and warding off; `ء م ن B001/B002` settled security and trusting assent; `ح ب ب B002` clinging attachment. The imperfect *yudāfiʿu* places continuing defense around the faithful. I infer that trust creates a protected relation in which harmful pressure is actively met. Faith reads here as inhabited security, not only assent.
2. **Betrayal and ingratitude undo relational adhesion.** `خ و ن B001/B002` is breach of loyalty and gradual diminishment; `ك ف ر B004` covers over favor; love's `ح ب ب B002` is clinging attachment. I infer that repeated betrayal slowly erodes the bond that acknowledged favor sustains. The divine non-love reads as relational incompatibility with agents who conceal and diminish trusts.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:60 later corrected defense with exact proportionality, renewed-oppression limits, and the simultaneous availability of pardon and protective covering.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Defense is counter-pressure, not exemption from conflict.** Fixed `يُدَافِع` activates `د ف ع:B001` (pushing away and warding off), while `ءَامَنُوا` activates `ء م ن:B001` (settled trust). `22:39` authorizes those already being fought, and `22:40` explains divine دفع through people checking other people. The packet supplies divine defense and its later social mechanism; I infer that protection can operate through countervailing human action rather than removal from danger. The ayah reads as active warding within history.
2. **Trust is defined by its opposites.** Fixed `خَوَّان` activates `خ و ن:B001` (breach of loyalty and trust), and `كَفُور` activates `ك ف ر:B004` (covering over a favor). Their universalized rejection follows a ritual section built on provision and gratitude. I infer that faith's protected relation is covenantal and responsive, not merely cognitive assent. Betrayal and ingratitude corrode the bond that defense sustains.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later `22:39` supplies authorization to those already attacked, and `22:40` gives the social mechanism and institutional beneficiaries. These ayat prevent “defense” from remaining an abstract promise.

baseline.text: Allah inananları savunur. Allah hiçbir hain ve nankörü sevmez.

findings.text: Allah'ın savunması, inananları çatışmadan muaf tutmak değil, üzerlerine gelen baskıya karşı etkin bir karşı kuvvet sağlamaktır.
Hainlik ve nankörlük, güven ilişkisinin yapışmasını bozan karşı özellikler olarak inananın kimliğini tersinden belirler.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly joins habitual betrayal with God's refusal of love, clarifying the focus's moral boundary.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It defines retaliation as equivalent and patience as better, bounding the protective force developed in the local passage.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its brief denial supplies only a general counterpart to the focus's ingratitude.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly addresses anticipated betrayal, requiring an open break rather than covert retaliation, and repeats God's rejection of traitors.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediate continuation permits resistance for those wronged and affirms God's capacity to aid them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It concerns the messenger's grief over disbelief, not the focus's protective action or betrayal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's rejection of transgression provides a broad ethical boundary but not the focus's particular treachery.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explains divine counterforce as preserving a plural set of places where God's name is remembered.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The youths' increase in guidance adds only a general portrait of believers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It couples believers with God's rejection of wrongdoers, but its battlefield testing is less direct than the local sequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The resurrection assertion does not clarify defense, betrayal, or ingratitude.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The accusation of ingratitude appears in a distinct dispute and gives little to the focus's paired moral traits.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its catalogue of communities and divine final judgment supplies the wider local frame for the distinction at 22:38.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It portrays fighting for the release of oppressed people who seek a protector and helper.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: A public declaration of belief gives only a general instance of the defended identity.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It distinguishes non-hostile people from combatants and commands justice, sharpening the limits of conflict.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It carries the local principle forward: a measured response to injury remains open to divine aid.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It associates disbelief with severe consequence but adds no protective or betrayal-specific relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It makes loyalty in another's absence central and denies success to the scheme of traitors.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It describes how those granted authority establish worship, giving, and moral restraint after the promised aid.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The absence of any repeller for punishment is a distant contrast to God's defense of believers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly pairs rescue followed by denial with treachery and ingratitude.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The timing of promised punishment does not develop the focus's defense or moral contrast.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its statement that punishment has no repeller is a negative counterpart, but it concerns disbelievers rather than protected believers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly forbids believers from betraying God, the messenger, and entrusted things.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contrasts the two allegiances in fighting and calls the believers' side to resist hostile power.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It shows that betrayal within intimate proximity cannot be offset by association with righteous people.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It protects communal wealth and life, offering an indirect social form of the non-betrayal ethic.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The creation and resurrection signs do not clarify the focus's protective action.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It connects believers' worship with a movement from fear to security, while warning against disbelief after that gift.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Repentance and the future honor of believers provide a broad outcome parallel only.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It grants the wronged party bounded authority and forbids excess, closely complementing the counterforce theme.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The exchange about prior unbelief does not add a distinct relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states the consequence for ingrates but is redundant after more specific treachery and ingratitude passages.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It presents fighting for God's way with reward, but says less about protection or restraint than earlier candidates.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The rhetorical question about later belief adds no specific clarification.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies removal of mercy as exposing human despair and ingratitude.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The claim of collective strength gives a faint contrast to reliance on divine aid.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Turning away and disbelieving is a general contrary response, without the focus's distinctive betrayal language.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It connects covenant-breaking, treachery, and hardened hearts, then commands pardon and excellence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Being driven to the Fire does not clarify the focus's relations.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The general woe for disbelievers is redundant and nonspecific.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It links human receipt of mercy with later ingratitude and places responsibility for response beyond the messenger.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It recognizes self-defense after wrong while refusing a further claim against the wronged party.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its bare statement of denial adds nothing beyond earlier disbelief candidates.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It commands repelling evil with what is better, giving a non-escalatory mode of response to harm.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Seeking refuge from hostile prompting is an indirect form of protection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies believers' faith in God as the sole stated motive for their persecution.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Arrogance, rejection of signs, and choosing error explain a broad pattern opposed to belief, but not the focus's defense.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The prison narrative does not clarify protection, betrayal, or ingratitude here.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It assigns deniers of the signs an adverse final identity, but adds no distinctive connection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly presents God repelling people through one another to prevent corruption in the earth.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The plea for refuge extends the protective motif but remains nonspecific.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It separates an outward claim of belief from actual belief, relevant to the focus's contrast of believers with corrupt traits.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It exposes a false profession of faith and a refusal to join defense, integrating belief, protection, and concealed disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It permits response to aggression but is less specific than the adjacent proportionality passages.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its rebuke of human ingratitude supplies a concise but general counterpart.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly says God does not love every persistent ingrate and sinner, echoing the focus's closing formula.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It pairs equivalent redress with pardon and repair, and rejects wrongdoing in the process.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The brief continuation of denial adds no new relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly identifies God as patron of believers and denies that patronage to disbelievers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It assigns blame and painful punishment to oppressive aggression, but repeats the prior redress frame.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It makes ingratitude the stated basis of recompense, clarifying the consequence side of the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contrasts reward for believing good works with God's rejection of disbelievers, but remains general.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The forecast of relief and pressing produce does not clarify the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: A pressured confession of belief provides only a limited contrast to durable belief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It links turning away from obedience with God's lack of love for disbelievers, but is generic.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The demand for angels does not develop the focus's themes.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It denies complete safety from divine punishment, a distant contrast to divine defense.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The ban on arrogance and boasting gives a broad moral correlate to conduct God does not love.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command for beautiful patience adds no specific relation after the retaliation passages.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It presents disbelief as rejecting the Creator and setting up rivals, a concrete form of ingratitude.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It restricts fighting to those who fight and prohibits transgression, directly limiting protective action.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The angels' ascent does not clarify defense, betrayal, or ingratitude.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It records witnesses to persecution of believers but adds little beyond the preceding verse.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It warns against proud exultation in gifts, a distant ethical counterpart to gratitude.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly opposes gratitude to ingratitude and makes remembrance reciprocal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It says those left astray have no helpers, a distant negative contrast to God's aid of believers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins withholding alms with disbelief in the hereafter, but does not specify the focus's protective relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contrasts faithful good works and wrongdoers under God's lack of love, but is general.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It orders intervention against an aggressing group until return, then restoration through justice.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states God's nearness to the God-conscious and excellent, giving a positive counterpart to divine support.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contrasts receptive submission with constricted disbelief, but is less direct than explicit belief and patronage texts.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It records wrongdoers mocking believers, a limited persecution counterpart.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states that universal ingratitude cannot diminish God's self-sufficiency and praise.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The certainty of God's promise to messengers supplies a broad assurance of divine backing.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It depicts people enjoying what they were given while becoming ungrateful, directly elaborating ingratitude.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contrasts devoted belief in God with rival loyalties and locates all power with God.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Guarding trusts and covenants provides the positive counterpart to the focus's treachery.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It calls believers to restraint before God and the messenger, a general loyalty instruction.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command to bless the prophet does not clarify the focus's themes.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its warning and call to God-conscious believers add only a general consequence frame.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The concise command to fear God and obey adds no specific clarification.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It stages arrogant elites openly rejecting what others believed, a concrete social form of disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It contrasts Satan's fear-inducing promise with God's promise of forgiveness and bounty, only indirectly related to protection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states persistent unbelief as an established condition but adds no distinct relation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It locates accountability with each person and names reverent worship, a broad moral complement to betrayal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Returning trusts to their owners and judging justly supplies a concrete opposite to betrayal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It warns against deceptive oaths and their harmful outcome, an indirect form of covenant treachery.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The secure enjoyment of fruits does not clarify the focus's defense or moral contrast.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It sets fighting against oppression within a limit: the conflict ends when coercive disorder ends.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It makes response to aggression proportionate and warns against overstepping, complementing the focus's protective counterforce.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states that no one can overcome those whom God helps, directly clarifying divine defense.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It names God as sufficient protector and sufficient helper against enemies.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It denies disbelievers a decisive way over believers, giving a direct outcome of divine protection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It requires justice even toward those hated and bars hostility from becoming transgression.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It presents a believing community loved by God, humble among believers and firm against disbelievers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It depicts believers seeking aid and receiving divine reinforcement in their conflict.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies God as the believers' protector and best helper.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It links changed favor to people changing themselves and names denial of God's signs, adding a causal frame for ingratitude.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly refers to intended betrayal after an earlier betrayal of God, then affirms divine power and knowledge.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It treats the breaking of sworn treaties as a ground for resisting the leaders of disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins fighting aggressors to divine punishment through believers' hands and help against them.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It recalls God's help in a moment of vulnerability and the strengthening of believers through tranquility.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies God as the believers' patron, grounding their reliance amid harm and benefit.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states God's established commitment to deliver messengers and believers.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It forbids breaking confirmed oaths made with God as guarantor, a direct covenantal counterpart to treachery.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It commands fulfillment of covenants and makes them accountable, supplying the positive opposite of betrayal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It recalls divine aid to believers under attack through forces they did not see.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly says God repelled the disbelievers' assault and spared believers the fighting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It portrays God protecting a believer from the evil consequences of his opponents' plotting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly promises support to messengers and believers in worldly life and at testimony.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies patience and forgiveness as a resolute response after injury, extending the focus beyond counteraction.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It makes helping God's cause reciprocal with God's help and firming believers' footing.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states that if disbelievers fought believers, they would turn away without protector or helper.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It affirms that God and His messengers will prevail, anchoring the focus's assurance of effective defense.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It distinguishes actual fighters and expellers from those at peace, giving the inverse boundary to 60:8's justice.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It calls believers to become helpers of God and recalls a group strengthened against its enemies.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 (22:38-57) - Counterforce Preserves a Plural Worship Ecology
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Legitimate force checks expulsion and demolition so that worship and public moral cultivation can remain embodied in places and institutions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Defense protects not one building type but an ecology of distinct sacred enclosures, then turns survival into civic maintenance rather than unrestricted dominance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Permission Activates Protective Counterforce
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Betrayal and oppression meet a permitted capacity to repel, fight, and receive aid.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: repelling and protecting `quranic:root_000480:B001/m01`; permission `quranic:root_000022:B004/m01`; fighting `quranic:root_001200:B011/m01`; grievance requiring redress `quranic:root_000967:B003/m01`; aid and victory `quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`; effective capacity `quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 22:38 `د ف ع`, `خ و ن`; 22:39 `ء ذ ن`, `ق ت ل`, `ظ ل م`, `ن ص ر`, `ق د ر`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Force enters as a bounded response to prior aggression. Permission, capacity, and aid form a counter-movement whose defining operation is to repel rather than originate expulsion.

pericope.label: Defense, opposed messengers, migration, and final striving

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınma eylemini ve bu eylemin yöneldiği varlığı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin tapınma eylemini veya kendini tapınmaya vermesini bildiren eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylem olarak tapınma çekirdeğini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun kendisine tapındığı varlık veya nesneden söz edilen ad bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tapınmanın yöneldiği varlık veya nesne anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir varlığın başkalarına tapınma konusu olarak benimsetilmesini anlatan ettirgen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir varlığı tapınma konusu durumuna getirme işlemini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kimi toplulukların tapındığı için bu adla anılan güneş

error_profile.preserves: Tapınılan varlık anlamını kısa ve doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Tapınma eylemini, kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini ve tapınılır kılma işlemini karşılamaz.
error_profile.collision: Yalnızca belirli bir varlık türünü adlandırdığı için bütün dalın karşılığı sanılabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tapınılan varlığı ve bir varlığı tapınılır kılma işlemini de adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tapınmayla birlikte yaklaşma ve kendini bu işe verme yönünü öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da tapınma eylemini ve kişinin bu eyleme yönelmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal eylem ve yaklaşma yönünde yoğunlaşırken bu dal aynı çekirdekten tapınılan varlık ile ettirgen kılma anlamlarını da türetir; bu yüzden yalnızca eylem bağlamında yakınlaşırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tapınmayı korku, inziva veya aşırı uygulama koşuluna bağlamaz ve tapınılan varlığı da adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Korkudan doğan, inziva veya ek yüklenme biçimindeki özel bir tapınma yaşayışını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel tapınma çekirdeğini ve ondan türeyen varlık anlamlarını kapsar; komşu dal ise korku, inziva ve olağanın üstündeki uygulamalarla sınırlı özel bir yaşayışı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Genel tapınma eylemini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaratıcıya özgü adı ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek ve ant kalıplarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: Yaratıcıya özgü ad ve kullanım kalıpları
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Özel ad, tapınılan yüce varlık düşüncesi üzerinden bu dalın varlık anlamıyla bağlantılıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel anlam örgüsünü verir; komşu dal ise o örgüden türemiş özel adı ve adın belirli söz kalıplarındaki kullanımını ayrı bir biçim alanı olarak sınırlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Tapınma eylemi, korkuya bağlı özel tapınma yaşayışı ve aynı kökün özel ad dalı sınırı keskinleştirdi; peygamberlik, büyücülük, belirli tapınma nesneleri, sahiplik ve tarihsel hizmet grubu adayları ise yalnızca aynı dinsel alana veya tekil örneklere temas ettiği için yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, bir şeyin belirli bir alıcıya yöneltildiği yapı ile sınırlıdır ve yalın köke genel bir verme anlamı yüklemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi belirli bir kişiye ulaştırarak ona vermek veya teslim etmektir.

facets.statement: Bir nesne, sahip olması ya da teslim alması için belirli bir alıcıya yöneltilir.
Yönelme yapısı, hareketin yalnızca yaklaşma değil verme ve ulaştırma sonucu doğurduğunu belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar, yöneltilen şeyin bir kişiye ulaşmasını ve ona verilmesini bu yapının ortak anlamı olarak sunar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin belirli bir alıcıya teslim edildiği yapının tam çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Nesneyi alıcıya ulaştırma ve verme sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir eşyanın belirli kişiye fiilen verildiği bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Nesnenin alıcıya ulaştırılıp verilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Gündelik ve resmiyet taşımayan verme bağlamlarını zayıf yansıtır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyi birine vermek veya ulaştırmak

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, verme, elden sunma, bağış ve verilen şeyin adı gibi daha geniş bir aileyi kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın sınırı belirli yönelme yapısı ve ulaştırma sonucudur; komşu dal genel verme alanını ve bundan türeyen adları da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda temel sonuç, bir nesnenin alıcıya verilmesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, teslim etmenin yanı sıra işi bırakma, yüzüstü bırakma veya bir durumu terk etme yönlerine uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyi başkasına teslim etme bağlamında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal nesnenin alıcıya ulaştırılmasıyla sınırlıyken komşu dal bırakma ve terk etme sonuçlarını da taşıyabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalda hareket eden şey alıcıya verilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda kişi, topluluk, yol veya bulut bir hedefe varır ya da yönelir; edinim ilişkisi yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir hedefe doğru yönelme ve erişme şeması bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal erişimi teslim ve verme sonucu ile tamamlar; komşu dal yalnızca hareket veya hedefe varmayı anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel verme, teslim etme ve yalnızca hedefe varma adayları bu yapının alıcıya teslim sınırını en iyi açıklar.
branches.branch_image_ar: دفع الشيء إلى غيره بمعنى إيصاله وإعطائه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تعدية الدفع بإلى حين يكون المدفوع شيئا يعطى أو يسلم إلى شخص.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس منه الدفع عن بمعنى الحماية، ولا دفع الشخص إلى شخص بمعنى الانتهاء إليه، ولا الطريق الذي يدفع إلى مكان.
branches.source_phrase_ar: دفعت إلى فلان شيئا (sihah)؛ إذا عدي بإلى اقتضى معنى الإنالة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hızlı ilerleme, bir hedefe ulaşma, konuşmaya koyulma, bulutun yön değiştirmesi ve bir grubun topluca varması kullanımlarını ortak bir yöneliş şemasında toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Alıcıya nesne verme, tek seferlik sıvı boşalması ve su yatağı adları bu hareket dalına dahil değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım hareket çekirdeğini korur; hız, konuşmaya giriş, hedefe varış ve toplu varış gibi yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleri ayrı yönler olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin, hayvanın ya da topluluğun hızla harekete geçip ilerlemesi veya bir hedefe varmasıdır. Yolun bir yere çıkması, konuşmaya koyulma, bulutun başka topluluğa yönelmesi ve bir grubun topluca varması bu hareket şemasının özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi, hayvan ya da topluluk öne doğru harekete geçer ve ilerler.
Hareket hızlı olabilir veya bir yolun, kişinin ya da topluluğun belirli bir hedefe ulaşmasıyla tamamlanabilir.
Konuşmaya koyulma, bulutun başka bir topluluğa yönelmesi ve bir grubun tek seferde varması aynı ilerleme şemasına dayanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar ilerleme ve hedefe ulaşma çekirdeğini; hızlanma, konuşmaya giriş, yön değiştiren bulut ve toplu varış örnekleriyle genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: atılıp ilerleme ve bir hedefe varma
concept_gloss.applicability: Hareketin başlamasını, sürmesini ve kimi kullanımlarda hedefe ulaşmasını birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: İleri yönlü hareketi ve hedefe erişme olasılığını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın ya da kişinin hız kazandığı hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hızlı ve ileri yönlü hareketi korur.
error_profile.loses: Yolun bir yere çıkması, konuşmaya giriş ve toplu varış yönlerini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin, yolun veya topluluğun belirli bir hedefte sonlandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hedefe erişme sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Hızlı ilerlemeyi ve konuşmaya koyulma gibi uzantıları dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal daha geniş bir hedefe ulaşma şeması taşır; komşu dalın belirgin alanı topluluğun bir amaçla yola çıkmasıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalın çekirdeği hareketin hafifliği ve hızıdır; özellikle hızlı hayvan hareketlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da hayvanın veya başka bir varlığın hızla ilerlemesinde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda yöneliş ve varış yapısı belirleyicidir; komşu dalda ise hafiflik ve sürat kendi başına çekirdektir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal hareket eden kişi, topluluk, yol veya bulutun hedefe ulaşmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir nesnenin alıcıya ulaştırılıp verilmesini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir hedefe yönelme ve erişme ilişkisi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın sonucu varış veya yöneliştir; komşu dalın sonucu nesnenin alıcıya teslimidir.
